name: Cloudflare R2 Standard
free_limit: R2 Standard: 10 GB-month storage, 1M Class A operations and 10M Class B operations per month; no egress fee
watch_out: The ongoing monthly free quota applies only to R2 Standard storage, NOT Infrequent Access (which also has retrieval fees). Storage and request usage above the allowance are billed; track billable-unit rounding and avoid confusing free egress with free storage.
